{{Quote|I'm Uli. I maintained machines in the Empire's Project Treshold, an experimental, uh, training program in the art of interrogation.|Uli Zhensi|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Uli Zhensi''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] until he decided to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], Uli and his fellow workers [[Bola (individual)|Bola]], [[Uthril]] and [[Nug]] maintained experimental interrogation machinery for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] [[Project Threshold]] until they were caught trying to sabotage the operation. Uli was able to escape, but his workers were captured by the Imperials. He eventually encountered a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizen and requested the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to assist him in ending the Empire's project by destroying the terminals controlling the equipment. The individual was successful in destroying the terminals and defeating the Imperial Archon that were guarding the place. Uli thanked the individual and went on to continue his work.<ref name="TOR" />
